story.title: Built from learning, curiosity, and a desire to create something real.
paragraphs: MiniShop started as a personal project to turn what I was learning about software development into a complete, working e-commerce application. Instead of building only a frontend or a simple CRUD project, I wanted to understand how a real application works from the user interface all the way to the database.

I built the frontend with Next.js and TypeScript, developed the backend with Java and Spring Boot, and use PostgreSQL hosted on Supabase for data storage. Along the way, I have been implementing authentication, product and category management, image storage, pagination, security, and an admin dashboard.

MiniShop continues to evolve as I learn. Every new feature gives me an opportunity to improve the architecture, write better code, and gain practical experience building a modern full-stack application.
